result.summary: The 2022 mission ('Give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together') was kept, but the 2023 page drops the 'Our Principles' section, the workforce-diversity statement and the 'Supported by 100% renewable energy' note. It adds a 'Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences' AR/VR innovation focus and 'the makeup of our company reflects the diverse perspectives'. Emphasis shifts toward innovation and the metaverse.
